title: InSight
tagline: The lander that listened to the heartbeat of Mars.
kicker: A true story from Mars · 2018 to 2022
mystery: How do you look inside a planet without moving an inch?
stat.mole: metres the mole aimed to dig
p1.launch: 5 May 2018. A rocket leaves California, with me on board.
p1.marco: Two tiny CubeSats called MarCO flew to Mars right behind me.
p1.hello: I am InSight. I didn't come to roam. I came to listen.
p1.flat: This plain is flat and smooth. Boring? Perfect! It's safe.
p1.vital: My job: check Mars' vital signs. Its pulse, its temperature, its reflexes.
p2.arm: First, my arm must set my ear on the ground.
p2.seis: SEIS is down! A dome shield keeps the wind and cold off it.
p2.first: No mission had ever studied the deep inside of Mars before.
p3.hint: Watch the line. Tap RECORD while it shakes.
p3.calm: Not yet. That's just the wind!
p3.win: Marsquakes and meteorite thumps. I can feel Mars' pulse!
p3.wind: I even heard the Martian wind. A low, spooky rumble.
p4.mole: Next: my heat probe, the mole. It must hammer almost 5 m down.
p4.stuck: Bonk… bonk… The soil was not what we expected. It couldn't get deep enough.
p4.rise: But my radio kept working. Tracking me showed how Mars wobbles.
p4.core: The wobble told scientists about Mars' iron-rich core.
p5.bye: I listened to Mars for four years. Now it's your turn to listen to me.
